name: Dr. Horacio Poblete
bio: Horacio Poblete received his PhD in Applied Sciences from Universidad de Talca in 2013. He was a postdoctoral fellow in the Theoretical Molecular Biophysics group at the U.S. National Institutes of Health and then at the Nanotechnology Innovation Center of Kansas State University, and returned to Universidad de Talca in 2017. He directs the university's doctoral program in Modeling of Chemical and Biological Systems. His research covers computational biophysics, nanotechnology, materials and protein structure.
